subject.title: fix(hooks): wire message:sending internal hook to user-defined hooks

question: Should HOOK.md internal hooks gain a new side-effect-only `message:sending` event, or should outbound message control and observation remain on the typed plugin hook surface?
rationale: Current docs deliberately separate coarse internal side-effect events from typed plugin control-flow hooks, while this PR creates a new cross-surface event and alias contract that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep typed plugin ownership
options.body: Reject the new internal event and direct filtering, auditing, and cancellation integrations to the existing typed `message_sending` plugin hook.

options.title: Approve observation-only event
options.body: Add a documented canonical `message:sending` internal event after the typed policy hook, carrying only the final non-cancelled payload and no underscore-wide alias.

options.title: Approve dual-name compatibility
options.body: Define both colon and underscore names as a supported compatibility contract with registration-time normalization, deduplication, documentation, and focused upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Keep typed plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Reject the new internal event and direct filtering, auditing, and cancellation integrations to the existing typed `message_sending` plugin hook.

likelyOwner.reason: The current hook-mapping and outbound channel-seam boundary traces to their merged refactor work.
